name: Liberty Capital Corporation
summary: GCI Liberty, Inc., through its various subsidiaries, operates in Alaska, delivering essential communication and technology solutions. The company provides a comprehensive suite of data, wireless, video, voice, and managed services. These offerings cater to a diverse array of clients, including residential users, commercial enterprises, government agencies, as well as educational and healthcare organizations. Its services are primarily marketed under the well-known GCI brand. Established in 1979, the company was initially known as GCI, LLC. GCI Liberty, Inc. maintains its corporate headquarters in Englewood, Colorado.
